Subject: Strategic readout + prioritization for QBR (decision requested)

Team — attaching a compact weekly readout and a short QBR prioritization workbook. This is a light status + decision request ahead of the QBR slide deck deadline next week. TL;DR: two decisions needed by Tue 11/24 EOD to lock slides and headcount ask.

Key wins (this week)
- Runtime: 95p generation latency down ~12% for long-tail workloads after kernel tuning — validated on 2 large customer profiles.
- Commercial: Closed renewal with BrightHealth (Dedicated) — upsell to reserved burst capacity included.
- Observability: Token-level cost dashboard rollout completed for internal beta (reduces cost-debug time).

Primary risks
1) Deployment stability: three separate canary rollbacks in last 10 days after model variant push (root cause: KV cache eviction heuristic). Risk: if not addressed, teams expect increased incident pages during Black Friday traffic test.
2) Compliance evidence lag: SOC2 evidence pack is 60% complete; security has flagged missing log-retention proof for Dedicated customers.
3) Hiring timeline: two infra hires delayed to Jan vs. planned Dec start — impacts Dedicated capacity expansion schedule.

Asks / decisions (please respond by Tue 2026-11-24 EOD)
A) Q1 Dedicated expansion: approve one-time $1.2M conversion of operating runway to Reserved capacity (enables predicted 30% throughput increase for enterprise pipeline).
B) Short-term stability mitigation: approve fast-track allocation for a 3-week reliability SWAT (contractors + priority infra hours) — estimated $120k.
C) QBR slide confirmation: confirm the single-slide framing for the infra ask (see attached workbook, sheet 'SlideText').

Attached: weekly_readout_20261122.pdf (4 pages), qbr_prio_rationale.xlsx (cost model + slide boilerplate). Drive folder with live deck: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR_Prep_2026

Notes: I've highlighted where we need explicit approvals in the workbook. If you want a 15-min sync tomorrow, I can carve time.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

Thanks Steph — quick read, looks thorough. A couple of clarifying asks before we greenlight A/B: 
- For the $1.2M Reserved ask (A), can you break down expected ROI by month for Q1 and Q2 (simple delta in unit cost / latency improvements)? The workbook has a high-level number, but finance will want the month-by-month cash flow.
- On risk #1 (canary rollbacks), is the KV cache heuristic fix scoped as a hotfix or a release that risks reintroducing latency regressions? If it's a risky codepath change, prefer SWAT mitigation B in parallel.

If you can answer both in-line here or drop a short note in the Drive sheet I can sign off.

-Laura
